channel.title: Homelab on Underkube
channel.description: Recent content in Homelab on Underkube

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Oct 4 - 10, 2026)
item.description: This week’s list is heavy on decompilations and native ports of old console games, next to a good batch of agentic tooling and a few infrastructure moves worth noting (gVisor into the CNCF, Deno into Cloudflare). Cloud, Infrastructure & Open Source gVisor is being donated to CNCF - The application kernel sandbox moves under the CNCF umbrella. Deno is joining Cloudflare - The runtime team explains why joining Cloudflare is the best place to keep building for the web.

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 26 - Oct 3, 2026)
item.description: Two frontier model releases landed this week next to a batch of agent runtimes and small decision models, and the open-weights GLM-5.3 release came with a security assessment worth reading. On the systems side there is homelab storage, Linux on Apple Silicon, ZFS tuning, and a good amount of PS5 and 3D printing tinkering. AI, Agents & Models Pi 1.0 / Pi Durable - The 1.0 release of a minimal, hardened agent harness, plus an experimental substrate for long-running, durable agents that can run anywhere.

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 19 - 26, 2026)
item.description: Two frontier model releases shared the week with a widening set of small decision models and agent runtimes, and with more reports on how coding agents are changing day-to-day development. Jev is still trending for the second week running, with benchmark tooling, an open implementation and drop-in skills for moving the small decisions off the frontier models. On the infrastructure side: kernel live-update work to keep VMs running, DRBD releases, router and Android tooling, and a Playdate app for watching live air traffic.

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 12 - 19, 2026)
item.description: Agent infrastructure dominated the week: Kubernetes-native harnesses, a high-density sandbox runtime on GKE, and a 27B model compressed into under 6 GB. Alongside that, BSD filesystem work, PipeWire audio tooling and a batch of retro-gaming archives. AI, Agents & Tools llmman - Runs any agent on any model, with the models themselves stored and shipped as OCI images. Mecatl - Stacklok’s open source, cloud-native harness for agents: the agent loop, the sandbox and the state are separate components, so a fleet runs on Kubernetes instead of on your laptop.

item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Sep 5 - 12, 2026)
item.description: A quieter week than the last one: open-weight audio tooling, Kubernetes checklists and Helm scanning, BSD install write-ups, a batch of homelab and SDR projects, and the Omarchy funding and vulnerability-disclosure threads. AI, Agents & Tools hexgrad/Kokoro-82M - An 82M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model, small enough to run locally and to fine-tune. santinic/audiblez - Generates audiobooks from EPUB e-books chapter by chapter, using Kokoro for the voices. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash - The smallest model in DeepSeek’s new architecture family, with native visual understanding and faster inference.
